title: Benchmark result row
description: One line in results/<modality>/<harness>.jsonl: one measurement, one process, one model load.

model.description: Model directory or repo id, including the quant.

label.description: Free-form config tag; the parameters that change the number.

valid.description: Passes the validity gates in docs/text/02-benchmark-plan.md. Invalid rows stay in the file.

metrics.description: Modality-owned numbers. Units belong in the key name.

harness.description: Versions, flags, and machine state (load, swap, thermal).
